items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: Joe was playing first. And I, we tried to work up, uh, Oliver Armstrong get up, you see, with the first and second cornets.

ctx.x: When did you join the Strauss?
Uh... Let's see now. Uh... I don't know exactly. I'll tell you. The fella whose place I took was, uh... I think it was from England. Or Ireland. Joe Lyatt. Yeah.
